name: Kazami Masaru
source:
"From now on… you will have to treat me like I'm your boyfriend."

A level-headed, highly competent advisor with a cool demeanor.

He becomes the "pseudo-boyfriend" for each heroine and interacts with them by "calling them out".

At times, correcting or scolding and other times encouraging, or pushing them forward, acting as needed. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3862740/Love_Advisor_Youre_a_mess_and_I_adore_you/]Steam[/url]]
